Mr. Rishab Ranghar, learned counsel, for the Applicants.

2. Mr. G.C. Joshi, learned AGA, for the State of Uttarakhand/1 and 2.
3.

The present Application has been filed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S, to quash the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.8181 of 2023, "Senior Food Safety Officer Vs. Food Business Operator/General Manager Anil Kapoor and another" under Section 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun.

sentences.text: 4. On the last date fixed on 05.05.2025, learned counsel for the Applicants had sought time for filing supplementary affidavit, which as per record has been filed, and is made part of the record.

To this,
learned State Counsel seeks time to verify the same.

Till the next date of listing, the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.8181 of 2023, "Senior Food Safety Officer Vs. Food Business Operator/General Manager Anil Kapoor and another" under Section 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, shall remain stayed.
